description: Get the estate's recent activity-log entries (who changed what, and when). Each entry has `who` (the person, and whether they're the owner or a collaborator) and `via` (the SwiftProbate app, Grace, or ChatGPT acting for them). Call this when the user asks what has changed recently or who did something — not for task or asset contents, which have their own tools. If no entry covers the change they ask about, say there is no record of who made it — never guess a cause.

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

name: get_activity_log
